description: This Java class 'ModelInfo' models the metadata and default values for entity models in the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to create instances from XML elements or attributes, encapsulates metadata such as title, description, copyright, author, version, and default resource name, and ensures immutability.

classes.name: ModelInfo
classes.description: An immutable class representing metadata about entity models, including title, description, copyright, author, version, and default resource name, with factory methods to instantiate from XML attributes and elements.

methods.name: createFromAttributes
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo instance using attribute values from an XML element, falling back to defaults if attributes are missing.

methods.name: createFromElements
methods.description: Creates a ModelInfo instance from child XML elements, falling back to defaults if elements are missing.

methods.name: getCopyrightString
methods.description: Generates a copyright string with year range from 2001 to the current year.
